title: Flowers at blue hour
alt: A florist holds white hydrangeas in the warm doorway of a flower shop after rain.
description: Cinematic blue-hour photography balances a detailed storefront, natural hand contact and wet reflections.
prompt: A richly detailed cinematic street photograph of a small flower shop at blue hour after rain. An adult female florist in a cream apron stands inside the open doorway, holding a terracotta pot of white hydrangeas naturally with both hands. The hands visibly grip and support the pot with plausible finger placement. Buckets of flowers, a tiled doorstep, a teal wooden door and warm hanging lamps form a layered storefront. Reflections in wet pavement, delicate petals, natural face and anatomy, realistic architectural proportions. Sophisticated cool-blue and amber colour, no legible signage or lettering.
